title: Asset tagging full flow (GRN + Rules studio)
description: End-to-end rehearsal of asset tagging on the seeded dataset, in order: role boundaries, national setup (G1 native sequence, Finance activation, product-type Finance Code), company code lists, office settings (with a taken-code refusal in a sibling office), enablement, GRN issuance (Govt. Tags from product type and line choice, an explicit standard tag, CSV, lookup, cross-office boundaries), needs-attention cases, the Rules studio turning the tag rule off and on for the office, and pause/resume. Needs --target local (super admin), --allow-writes, an office with an opened stock ledger and ASSET_TAGS_SINGLE_ISSUER=true + ASSET_TAGS_REHEARSAL=true (gates G5/G6). Issued tags and posted GRNs are permanent and listed as retained.
